title: Custom Pickleball Social Club Shirt, Personalized Town Name Pickleball Club Tee, Retro Team Gift
description:
Your town, your club, your year. A retro crest for pickleball groups that want matching shirts.

Who it's for:
- Neighbourhood, retirement community and church groups
- Leagues, ladders and tournament organisers
- Anyone who wants a hometown pickleball shirt

About the design:
An arched town name above crossed paddles, a bold 'PICKLEBALL', a 'SOCIAL CLUB' ribbon and an 'EST.' year. Personalise the town (shown as OAKWOOD) and the year.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Retro Oakwood Pickleball Social Club crest with crossed paddles and a ribbon on a natural tee.
